name: Centrophenoxine
summary: Cholinergic compound with a DMAE compotent. It is thought to help in reversing some signs of aging. Naturally found substance, most notably in fish.

pharmacology.text: Meclofenoxate, also known as Centrophenoxine or Lucidril is a nootropic that acts as a precursor to choline.

uses.en: It has been sold as a medicine in some countries for memory problems and confusion in older people, and is taken as a nootropic supplement. Good evidence for its benefits is limited.
uses.zh: 在部分國家，它曾作為藥物用於改善老年人的記憶問題與意識混亂，也被當成益智補充品服用。支持其效果的可靠證據有限。
uses.zhHans: 在部分国家，它曾作为药物用于改善老年人的记忆问题与意识混乱，也被当成益智补充品服用。支持其效果的可靠证据有限。

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include headache, sleeplessness, restlessness, nausea and stomach upset.
sideEffects.zh: 被報告的作用包括頭痛、失眠、坐立不安、噁心與腸胃不適。
sideEffects.zhHans: 被报告的作用包括头痛、失眠、坐立不安、恶心与肠胃不适。

fact.en: Centrophenoxine joins DMAE to 4-chlorophenoxyacetic acid, a synthetic version of auxin, the hormone plants use to control their growth.
fact.zh: 甲氯芬酯是把 DMAE 和 4-氯苯氧乙酸結合而成，後者是植物生長激素「生長素」的人工合成版本，植物用它來調控生長。
fact.zhHans: 甲氯芬酯是把 DMAE 和 4-氯苯氧乙酸结合而成，后者是植物生长激素「生长素」的人工合成版本，植物用它来调控生长。
